activity.role: Captain at the Army General Staff
activity.notes: The French Service historique de la Défense identifies Alfred Dreyfus as a capitaine stagiaire at the Army General Staff in 1894, when he was arrested and accused of high treason. ATLAS uses only this source-backed 1894 military anchor and does not turn the Dreyfus Affair or his lifespan into a synthetic continuous rail.

sources.title: Alfred Dreyfus (1859-1935)
sources.citation_text: The French Service historique de la Défense describes Dreyfus as a trainee captain at the Army General Staff in 1894 and documents his arrest, conviction, later rehabilitation, and return to the army.
